title: Design System: Proxy Start Native Application Manager

display.purpose: 24px/600 page titles such as 应用, 代理设置, and 系统设置.

title.purpose: 24px/600 page-heading token; settings section headings use the smaller 18px/600 treatment.

body.purpose: 14px root UI text for controls, navigation labels, and application names.

secondary.purpose: 12px counts, descriptions, helper copy, paths, and runtime detail.

label.purpose: 13px/600 settings field labels and compact status headings.

breakpoints.name: table-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Drop the Mode column and compress proxy/status/action widths.

breakpoints.name: inspector-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Switch the selected application to a separate full-width detail view below this width; at or above it, use the fixed 300px right inspector.

components.name: Installed Application Picker
components.description: A 680x580 native modal clamped to the host window, with a 36px focused search field, counts and virtualized 60px rows. Each row has a friendly software name, a real 32px system icon or neutral fallback and an 80x36 action. Already-added launch entries show a disabled 已添加 action by stable identity. Microsoft and Windows system software are hidden by default, disclosed in the count and controlled by the persisted 隐藏系统软件 switch in 系统设置. Up to four visible-row icon requests run asynchronously; closing cancels them.

components.css: .ds-installed-picker { box-sizing: border-box; width: 680px; max-width: calc(100vw - 48px); height: 580px; max-height: calc(100vh - 48px); padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #DCE1E8; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #202938; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; } .ds-installed-picker input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 36px; background: #F3F5F7; border: 1px solid #DCE1E8; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-installed-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 60px; } .ds-installed-row button { width: 80px; height: 36px; }

components.name: Proxy Settings Table
components.description: A bounded proxy profile table with the columns 名称, 地址, 协议, 默认标记, and 操作. Every row exposes 打开代理控制台, 编辑, and 删除; the page header exposes 新增代理.

components.css: .ds-proxy-table { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; max-width: 1060px; border: 1px solid #DCE1E8; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #FFFFFF; color: #202938; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; } .ds-proxy-table header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 88px; padding: 20px 24px 16px; } .ds-proxy-head, .ds-proxy-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(150px, 1fr) 100px 90px 270px; gap: 0; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; } .ds-proxy-head { min-height: 38px; background: #F3F5F7; color: #667085; font: 600 12px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; } .ds-proxy-row { min-height: 68px; border-top: 1px solid #DCE1E8; } .ds-proxy-row button { height: 34px; margin-right: 6px; }

components.name: Proxy Profile Modal
components.description: The shared native modal for adding and editing a proxy. It includes name, address, protocol, optional authentication, default selection, and test actions. Delete opens a separate confirmation modal.
components.html:
新增代理

components.css: .ds-profile-modal { box-sizing: border-box; width: 520px; max-width: calc(100vw - 48px); padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #DCE1E8; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #202938; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; } .ds-profile-modal label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; font: 600 13px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; } .ds-profile-modal input, .ds-profile-modal select { height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #DCE1E8; border-radius: 8px; background: #F3F5F7; } .ds-profile-modal footer { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: 20px; }

components.name: Proxy Console Action
components.description: The primary row action that opens a new platform shell with the selected profile's scoped proxy environment. Only tools that read proxy environment variables are affected; the action communicates shell creation, not verified target connectivity.
components.css: .ds-proxy-console { height: 34px; padding: 0 11px; background: #2C6DE8; color: #FFFFFF; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; } .ds-proxy-console:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 120, 246, 0.52); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: System Settings Column
components.description: A single scrolling settings column capped at 760px with the sections 外观, 应用列表, and 强制代理组件. The system software switch remains reachable when no proxy profile exists.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-system-settings { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 26px; } .ds-system-settings section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding-bottom: 26px; border-bottom: 1px solid #DCE1E8; } .ds-system-settings h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 16px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; }

components.name: Floating Operation Toast
components.description: A top-right floating notification that does not reserve footer space. Success expires after about four seconds; pending feedback remains until a result replaces it; errors remain until the user closes them.
components.css: .ds-toast { box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 420px; margin: 16px; padding: 10px 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid #DCE1E8; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #202938; font: 400 12px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; }

components.name: Product Mark
components.description: The shared geometric mark used in the sidebar lockup, window icon, tray icon, and shortcut asset.
components.css: .ds-brand-mark { display: inline-grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; } .ds-brand-mark svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: block; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single clear action for adding, starting, or saving on the current surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2C6DE8; color: #FFFFFF; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2563D9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1D4ED8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 120, 246, 0.52); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet adjacent action such as adding an installed app, testing, or deleting.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #F3F5F7; color: #202938; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #DCE1E8; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #E9EDF2; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #DEE5ED; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 120, 246, 0.52); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: A compact search field aligned with the launch filters; it is 248px wide at the default window and grows in compact layouts.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.8" cy="10.8" r="6.5"></circle><path d="m16 16 4.5 4.5"></path></svg><input placeholder="搜索应用"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 248px; height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; background: #F3F5F7; border: 1px solid #DCE1E8; border-radius: 8px; color: #667085; } .ds-search svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #202938; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #2C6DE8; outline: 0; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: The selected workspace destination in the quiet blue-gray rail. The rail contains exactly 应用, 代理设置, and 系统设置.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; background: #2C6DE8; color: #FFFFFF; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #2563D9; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 120, 246, 0.52); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Application Table Row
components.description: A scanable application row with real icon, proxy assignment, honest runtime state, and actions.

components.css: .ds-app-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 56px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #202938; border-bottom: 1px solid #DCE1E8; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; } .ds-app-row:hover { background: #F3F5F7; } .ds-app-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; color: #245AC2; background: rgba(52, 120, 246, 0.23); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-app-icon svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-app-name { flex: 1; min-width: 140px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-app-proxy { width: 166px; } .ds-app-status { width: 116px; color: #A85A08; font-size: 12px; } .ds-row-action { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: #F3F5F7; color: #202938; border: 1px solid #DCE1E8; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; } .ds-row-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 120, 246, 0.52); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Inspector Field
components.description: A labeled editor field in the selected-program inspector or proxy settings form.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: #202938; font: 600 13px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; background: #F3F5F7; color: #202938; border: 1px solid #DCE1E8; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; outline: 0; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 120, 246, 0.52); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Runtime Status
components.description: A compact semantic runtime label that distinguishes applied or verified state from merely running.
components.css: .ds-status-warning { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #A85A08; font: 400 12px 'Microsoft YaHei UI'; } .ds-status-warning > span { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #A85A08; }

narrative.overview:
Proxy Start is a native Windows and macOS utility used while the user is thinking about another application. The interface is calm, legible, and operational: a pale blue-gray rail contains the brand lockup and exactly three workspace destinations: 应用, 代理设置, and 系统设置. The working surface gives the application list or settings table its full visual priority. The supplied application-manager reference informs the hierarchy, compact rows, sidebar material, and restrained table rhythm; the product remains a native proxy tool with concise Chinese copy and native controls.

The system uses one blue interactive voice over theme-derived surfaces. Light mode keeps the main work surface white and the rail pale blue-gray; dark mode uses charcoal-blue surfaces without inverting status semantics. Color is reserved for selection, primary actions, focus, the shared brand mark, and honest runtime/probe states. Depth comes from surface changes and fine borders rather than decoration or floating cards. System settings use a single 760px column; operation feedback is a top-right floating toast with no reserved footer. Platform capabilities come from the application snapshot: macOS uses system-ui, presents Codex native support and clearly unavailable forced-proxy controls.
keyCharacteristics: Native desktop posture with a 214px work rail and a spacious working surface, with platform-native fonts.
Compact, scanable application table with stable semantic columns and real application icons.
Proxy settings use a clear profile table and modal editing flow; system settings use a single 760px column.
The proxy console action opens a platform shell with a scoped environment and never implies verified connectivity.
One blue action voice; green, amber, and red only carry runtime or probe meaning.
Light, dark, and system themes share the same structure and spacing rhythm.
No gradients, fake connectivity indicators, invented usage statistics, or decorative dashboards.

rules.name: The One Blue Voice Rule
rules.body: Use product blue for action, selection, focus, and the active rail destination. Do not turn every informational label into accent-colored decoration.

rules.name: The Honest State Rule
rules.body: Green means an actual applied, ready, or verified result; amber means pending, forced, or attention-needed; red means failure. A launched process alone never earns a verified state.

rules.name: The Weight Before Size Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with weight and spacing before introducing a larger type size; keep dense tables readable without oversized labels.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Prefer a surface shift or a one-pixel border to a shadow. Use a stronger border only for drag-over, focus, or an explicit error state.

dos: Do use the theme tokens for every surface, border, text, selection, focus, and state color so system, light, and dark modes remain coherent.
Do keep the 214px rail, 24px content inset, 88px page header, and 4/8/12/16/24/28px spacing rhythm unless a responsive rule requires compression.
Do preserve the stable table column grid and let the Name column absorb available width.
Do keep long detail bodies scrollable while leaving their 36px action bar reachable.
Do let proxy and system settings scroll within their own content columns, keep modal actions in one wrapping row, and place operation feedback in the top-right toast viewport.
Do expose real operation progress, disabled duplicate actions, wrapped errors, and clear recovery actions.
Do keep drag-and-drop discoverable through the table surface and a restrained accent border while dragging.
donts: Don't add gradients, glassmorphism, decorative shadows, fake connectivity indicators, or invented usage statistics.
Don't use a blue label for a state merely because it looks active; reserve semantic colors for their documented meanings.
Don't hide the selected-program inspector in repeated table rows or make it permanently consume narrow-window width.
Don't claim proxy connectivity because a target process started; retain the distinction between applied, running, and verified.
Don't replace native Windows controls with web-shaped controls, oversized cards, or a decorative empty drop zone.
